meetings.title: Monday standup
transcript: Maya: Morning. Sixteen days to FreightWorks, so let's go around fast. Arjun?
Arjun: The slot-scoring endpoint works on test data. I can't wire in real recommendations until Nina's ranking lands.
Nina: Ranking is about two days out. TW-116 will be up by Wednesday.
Leila: The slot picker is built on placeholder screens. I need Sam's final designs to finish it.
Sam: Final screens today, by three. Then I start the Expo demo flow.
Jordan: Coastal can go live once the API is stable. Valley is still sorting out data access on their side. I'm also building the Harbor QBR deck for Thursday.
Maya: How is the Harbor renewal looking?
Jordan: The order form went out Friday. Dana said it should be routine.
Maya: Great. Then for the next two weeks Smart Slots is the priority for everyone. Expo is our shot at the next twenty customers.
Arjun: One flag. Sync errors were at 1.6 percent yesterday, mostly Ridgeline's duplicates.
Maya: Let's look at that after Expo unless it gets worse. Anything else?
Nina: Harbor asked about the 5,000-row export limit again.
Jordan: I told them it's on the list. That can wait until after Expo, right?
Maya: Yes. No side quests until Expo.
